gskybox89 v1.2 asset convention update
======================================

Compiler:
  cc -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror -O2

Build:
  make clean
  make all
  OK

Core checks:
  ./test_build
  OK

Geometry:
  cube fast path: 8 shared cube corners
  cube triangles: 6 faces * 2 triangles = 12 tris
  hybrid preview: screen=1 cube=12 dome=112 total=125

New asset layer:
  include/gskybox89_assets.h
  src/gskybox89_assets.c

Supported mapping conventions:
  Source6: FT/BK/LF/RT/UP/DN
  Axis6:   px/nx/py/ny/pz/nz
  Word6:   front/back/right/left/up/down/top/bottom

Source helpers:
  VMF skyname extraction
  VMT $basetexture extraction

Demo decoders:
  BMP 24/32 uncompressed
  TGA 24/32 uncompressed
  PPM P6

Tested with uploaded cases:
  sky_night01 Source-style VMT/VMF/TGA/BMP
  sky_105 axis-style px/nx/py/ny/pz/nz PNG converted to PPM for demo preview

Generated previews:
  preview_asset_sky_night01_bmp.png
  preview_asset_sky_night01_tga.png
  preview_asset_sky_105_axis_ppm.png

Note:
  Original uploaded texture files are not bundled into this package.
